name: groundstead
description: Groundstead / Đất Lành: chuẩn bị khẩn cấp và lộ trình sống tự chủ (tên làm việc, chưa tra nhãn hiệu xong).

scripts.build: node tools/checks/content-validate.mjs && NEXT_TELEMETRY_DISABLED=1 next build && node tools/build/postbuild.mjs
scripts.test: node tools/loop/run-node-tests.mjs --out .loop/node-tests.json tools/loop/backlog.test.mjs tools/loop/matrix.test.mjs tools/checks/secret-scan.test.mjs tests/seo.test.ts tests/i18n.test.ts tests/bundle-scan.test.ts tests/content.test.ts tests/help.test.ts tests/emergency.test.ts tests/landing.test.ts tests/readiness.test.ts tests/boundary.test.ts tests/offline.test.ts tests/e2e/smoke.e2e.mjs tests/e2e/offline.e2e.mjs tests/e2e/a11y.e2e.mjs
scripts.verify: npm run check:secrets && npm run check:backlog && npm run build:test && npm run typecheck && npm run check:bundle-secrets && npm run test
